670:t_1:171.en:
$$ランカ$$
「Yeah... I'll wait for you, as long as it takes.」

670:t_1:172.en:
$$ランカ$$
「So... please come back to me, $$アルト$$.」

670:t_1:177.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Girl with the pale green hair. I will not allow you alone to find happiness.」

670:t_1:178.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$ミカゲ$$! When did you get aboard the $$クォーター$$?!」

670:t_1:180.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You must pay for betraying the girl with the pink and golden hair.」

670:t_1:183.en:
$$ランカ$$
「...I'm sorry, $$アルト$$... You're busy too, but I made you indulge my selfishness...」

670:t_1:184.en:
$$アルト$$
「I don't mind. Anyone would be scared in a situation like this.」

670:t_1:185.en:
$$アルト$$
「Besides, the captain asked me to look after you.」

670:t_1:186.en:
$$ランカ$$
「Are you only spending time with me because my brother told you to...?」

670:t_1:188.en:
$$ランカ$$
「...You're so kind, $$アルト$$... But sometimes... that hurts...」

670:t_1:190.en:
$$ランカ$$
「I'm sorry... But I... I think I've reached my limit...」

670:t_1:191.en:
$$ランカ$$
「I know it's unfair to do this while $$シェリル$$ isn't here... But... if we're going to die here like this...」

670:t_1:192.en:
$$アルト$$
「Stop, $$ランカ$$. Don't give up hope.」

670:t_1:193.en:
$$ランカ$$
「I... I love you, $$アルト$$!」

670:t_1:200.en:
$$ランカ$$
「It's strange... Hearing how you feel scares me so much... so much more than singing in battle...」

670:t_1:204.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The seeds of hatred and jealousy finally bear fruit. I've come for you, girl with the pale green hair.」

670:t_1:205.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$ミカゲ$$! When did you get aboard the $$クォーター$$?!」

670:t_1:207.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Now, come with me, and bring your unrequited love.」

670:t_2:3.en: ～$$フロンティア船団$$　$$バトル・フロンティア$$　Bridge～

670:t_2:5.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「The merger of the $$クィーン#vajra$$ and $$バトル・フロンティア$$ is nearly complete.」

670:t_2:6.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「They are connected by cables, so even $$熱気バサラ$$'s $$フォールドウェーブ$$s shouldn't be able to interfere.」

670:t_2:8.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「Our original plan was to let them clear out the $$宇宙怪獣$$ nest before putting our plan into action.」

670:t_2:9.en:
$$三島$$
「It doesn't matter. With the $$バジュラ$$'s power, even they are nothing to fear.」

670:t_2:10.en:
$$三島$$
「In the worst case, we simply transfer to a parallel world.」

670:t_2:11.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「What do you intend to do with Miss $$ストライカー#pilot$$?」

670:t_2:12.en:
$$三島$$
「She is a capable system. Of course, I'll have her serve until the end as a soldier building my ideal society.」

670:t_2:13.en:
$$三島$$
「And what makes her most wonderful of all is...」

670:t_2:14.en:
$$三島$$
「That she has no selfish desires.」

670:t_2:15.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「...What do you think you're doing?」

670:t_2:16.en:
$$三島$$
「Don't play dumb, $$グレイス・ゴドゥヌワ$$. You claimed to be the $$ギャラクシー船団$$'s sole survivor, but that was a lie, wasn't it?」

670:t_2:18.en:
$$三島$$
「My subordinates have already captured or eliminated your implant soldiers.」

670:t_2:19.en:
$$三島$$
「It's a shame. If you had been my sincere ally, I wouldn't have had to do this.」

670:t_2:20.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「Are you planning to eliminate me?」

670:t_2:21.en:
$$三島$$
「It's useless to try to escape. I've already stationed soldiers on this bridge.」

670:t_2:22.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「$$レオン・三島$$... It seems I underestimated you.」

670:t_2:23.en:
$$三島$$
「The humiliations I endured since the $$再世戦争$$ made me stronger. Perhaps I should thank $c for that.」

670:t_2:24.en:
$$三島$$
「Then farewell, $$グレイス・ゴドゥヌワ$$.」

670:t_2:25.en:
$$三島$$
「Now that the $$ギャラクシー船団$$ is gone, once you lose that body, you won't be able to load your backed-up memories into another.」

670:t_2:27.en:
$$三島$$
「You both have mechanical bodies. If only you had Miss $$ストライカー#pilot$$'s purity too.」

670:t_2:29.en:
$$三島$$
「...I learn too, you know. Don't think you can use me twice.」

670:t_2:30.en:
$$新統合軍兵$$
「What... should we do with this woman?」

670:t_2:31.en:
$$三島$$
「I have no use for broken machinery. Dispose of her.」

670:t_2:33.en:
$$三島$$
「...Now no one can stand in the way of my conquest.」

670:t_2:34.en:
$$三島$$
「Soon, the ruler of this galaxy will be decided. And the universe will enter a new era!」

670:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Two brothers risk their lives against the enemy to save their little sister, $$ランカ$$...」

670:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Their devotion produced 100 Z in $$Ｚチップ$$s... I'll add them to the squad's stock.」

670:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Please remember, $$ランカ$$... So many people protect you and your song...」

670:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Once again, this is hardly the time to be saying all that, but $$Ｄトレーダー$$ is open for business!」

670:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Our celebration for the ace pilots will have to wait, but today we're ready to... sell, sell, sell!」
